headline: Chief Engineer of Bahamas-Flagged Tanker Dies After Evacuation in Varna
summary: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund Danantara targets 2026 dividends of Rp100-160 trillion. It estimates 2025 dividends at Rp143 trillion, with Rp11 trillion already paid to the state.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's state investment holding company, which manages stakes in many state-owned enterprises. Its dividend flows affect government revenue and the capital position of its portfolio companies.
